title: StraitsX partners OCBC for corporates to receive stablecoin payments into accounts
message_html: StraitsX partners OCBC for corporates to receive stablecoin payments into accounts ...
snippet: Singapore stablecoin issuer StraitsX is partnering with OCBC bank to pilot stablecoin cross border payments for corporates.
